subject.title: fix(mattermost): proactive message tool sends ignore thread context

question: Which path should own the remaining Mattermost cron/heartbeat thread-context fix now that the message-tool path has shipped?
rationale: The remaining bug is real, but linked candidate PRs overlap and are not currently clean landing paths; choosing whether to adopt, replace, or close those branches is a maintainer ownership decision.

options.title: Sponsor a focused replacement
options.body: Create or request a narrow replacement that persists non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and proves cron/heartbeat wake replies in the original thread.

options.title: Adopt an existing candidate
options.body: Pick one linked PR, rebase it, resolve the route/session risks, and make it the canonical fix path.

options.title: Close remaining scope as not planned
options.body: Close this issue and associated candidates only if maintainers decide cron/heartbeat recovery into Mattermost threads is no longer supported.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a focused replacement
recommendation.body: Create or request a narrow replacement that persists non-direct Mattermost delivery context on the correct session entry and proves cron/heartbeat wake replies in the original thread.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the shipped partial fix and explicitly scoped the remaining behavior in the linked maintainer comment.
